wrong_setting: The low houses have orange-red clay tile roofs and stucco walls that read as a Mediterranean or Latin American hill town rather than Addis Ababa's corrugated tin roofs.
notes: Repaint the low houses with corrugated tin roofs, grey, rusted and blue-painted metal instead of red clay tiles, so the city reads as Addis Ababa; keep everything else.
